title: Megurine Luka — Starting Point〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: Our Starry Sky Leading to the Future

rows.Line: School SEKAI
Station

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh...
se_walk_women_001_1

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I had a feeling you'd be here.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Rin's been saying how she wants to have a jam session with you.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Really...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Is what we discussed in the classroom still bothering you...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You really are like a mind reader, Luka.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I'm a little embarrassed about this, so please don't tell the others...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But a lot of things went through my mind when the possibility of Ichika and the others graduating came up.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Could you elaborate...?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: For example...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We've already fulfilled the big role of helping the girls realize their true feelings and singing the song that came from this SEKAI with them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Also...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Seeing their music video being played on digital billboards and hearing people talk about how great their song is makes me so happy and proud of them...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But a part of me also feels a little sad...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Maybe it does feel like they'll end up somewhere really far away.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You must be feeling that way because you care about them so much and don't want to be without them.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: It's weird, right? I mean, I should be happy about how much they've grown and their success as a band.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh? I don't think what you're feeling is weird.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Because I also feel a little sad each time you take a big step forward, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? Why's that?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Well...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The more you keep growing, Miku, the fewer chances I'll have to help you as your senior since you'll likely start needing me less and less.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: I don't know if what I'm feeling is the same as what you're feeling about Ichika and the others...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: But if there is some overlap, then it might be good for you to change your perspective a bit.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Huh? What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: It's easy.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Instead of thinking that they're going somewhere far away, you should see it as them coming closer.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
To me, you're my junior.
But the more you improve, the more of an equal footing we reach as bandmates.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Does that make sense...?
If you ask me, I think that's a rather exciting prospect.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Also, as your senior, the possibility of you surpassing me drives me to keep improving.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Interesting. I never thought to see things that way...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: You really are amazing, Luka...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I have trouble understanding what I'm feeling sometimes, which sort of leads me to see things in black and white...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hehe. I suppose I do have a bit of a lead on you there as your senior.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
*Nod*
I mean, Luka, you're still my senior in plenty of ways.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: I like to think we're equal as performers...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: But you're always there to help whenever I have to face my own feelings or someone else's, or when I just have something on my mind.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: The girls might feel the same way about you, Miku.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
Y-You think so...?
That'd be nice, but...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Then, why don't you ask them when they visit next?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: What?! No, that'd be so embarrassing...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh?

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Luka...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: That's something I'll never be able to emulate.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: See what I mean? I still want to make it feel like I'm your senior.

rows.Speaker: Luka & Miku
rows.Line:
Hehe.
Haha.
